theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_slice_density_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ) (a : Eucl N) (j : Fin N), SFinite μ → IsSigmaCompact E → μ Eᶜ = 0 → (volume : Measure (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N)) {u : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N | ¬ (∃ x ∈ E, x ≠ a ∧ dist x a < δ ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i) x) : Eucl (m + 1)) = (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i) a) : Eucl (m + 1))) ∧ 0 < limsup (fun t : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ (ball a r ∩ {x | x ≠ a ∧ ∃ c ∈ ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) t, (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i + c i • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1)) = 0}) / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * t) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) ∧ limsup (fun t : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ (ball a r ∩ {x | x ≠ a ∧ ∃ c ∈ ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) t, (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i + c i • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1)) = 0}) / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * t) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) < ⊤} = 0
